levels.name: First steps
levels.hint: Tap Forward three times, then press Run.

levels.name: Shiny gem
levels.hint: Walk over the gem to pick it up, then on to the flag.

levels.name: Round the corner
levels.hint: Turn right turns the robot on the spot. It does not move.

levels.name: Left this time
levels.sol: F F F L F F
levels.hint: Pick up the gem, then turn left to face the flag.

levels.name: Zigzag
levels.sol: F R F L F R F L F
levels.hint: Right, left, right, left: one square at a time.

levels.name: Turn around
levels.sol: F F R R F F F F F
alt: F F L L F F F F F
levels.hint: Get the gem first. Two turns make the robot face the other way.

levels.name: Round the pond
levels.sol: F F F F R F F R F F F F
levels.hint: Go all the way round the water. Robots cannot swim!

levels.name: Long walk
levels.sol: F F F R F F R F F F L F F
levels.hint: A long walk with two gems. Plan it one square at a time.
